subject: Collecting availability & assembling Zoom bridge for technical walkthrough

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Collecting availability & assembling Zoom bridge for technical walkthrough

Hi Samir / Olivia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we can lock a focused technical walkthrough for your infra and application owners: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary goal: validate integration pattern for token streaming and prefix caching with your API gateway.
- Constraints: VPC peering suggested, and Egress rules for KV cache endpoints.
- Stakeholders: Olivia (app), Rajesh (SRE), Samir (decision owner).

Proposed next step:
- 60-minute technical walkthrough: Redwood Solutions Engineer + one infra engineer, + your SRE and app owner.
- Agenda (high level): environment and access, model selection & perf targets, failover/fallback routing, integration runbook.

Could you confirm who will join from your side and which of these slots works (all PT):
1) Tue Oct 24 — 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed Oct 25 — 09:00–10:00 PT
3) Thu Oct 26 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Also: do you prefer Zoom or Google Meet for the session? We can provide an authenticated Zoom bridge if that helps with remote access to logs and screen sharing.

I attached a short ops checklist that helps us scope any network access we should request ahead of time. If you can share a short list of hosts/IPs we should be able to reach from our side, that will speed the prep.

Thanks — I’ll hold the earliest slot provisionally until I hear back.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: brief-ops-checklist.pdf]

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. Quick replies: 

- Attendees from MedSync: Olivia Grant (app owner), Rajesh Iyer (SRE). I will join as well but may be pulled into another call.
- Preferred slot: Wed Oct 25 — 09:00–10:00 PT (slot #2).
- Zoom is preferable for us (company policy for external vendors).
- We’ll need the Zoom link and an ICS so we can get this onto calendars.

On the network items: Rajesh will follow up with a short list of IP ranges we can open, but please assume we allow outbound only and will not provide inbound SSH. If you need anything more concrete to test, flag it and we’ll see what security can enable.

Thanks,
Samir
